name: Nemetschek SE
summary: Nemetschek SE provides software solutions for architecture, engineering, construction, operation, and media industries in Germany, the rest of Europe, the Americas, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Design, Build, Manage, and Media. The Design segment offers software solutions primarily under the Allplan, Graphisoft, and dRofus brands for architects, designers, engineers, structural engineers, specialist planners, and landscape designers, as well as developers and general contractors.
